subject: Brightleaf Systems CAIQ prep: scheduling, priority sections, and evidence owners
messages:
From: Anna Keller <anna.keller@brightleaf.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@brightleaf.io
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ session — scheduling and priority areas

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are moving toward a standard vendor assurance review and would like to schedule a focused CAIQ session to walk through a few sections and collect evidence. Our primary goals are to validate data residency controls and network segregation for production workloads.

Can you share 2x 45-minute slots this week or early next? Also helpful if you can call out who on your side will be the evidence owners for the following areas:
- Data residency / storage encryption
- Network architecture / segmentation
- Access provisioning / IAM audit logs

We have a short internal pre-call on Friday and want to lock this with your team beforehand.

Best,
Anna Keller
Security Program Manager
Brightleaf Systems

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Keller <anna.keller@brightleaf.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ session — scheduling and priority areas

Hi Anna —

Thanks for the note. Available slots (PST):
- Thu 2027-07-22 10:00–10:45 AM
- Thu 2027-07-22 2:00–2:45 PM
- Mon 2027-07-26 9:30–10:15 AM

For the areas you listed, proposed owners:
- Data residency / storage encryption — Marissa Cole (I’ll loop her in below)
- Network architecture / segmentation — Soojin Lee
- Access provisioning / IAM audit logs — Logan Wright (me)

I’m attaching our blank CAIQ template and a brief network diagram (high level) to speed the call. Please confirm which slot works and whether you want the call to be recorded.

Attachments: CAIQ_v3_template.xlsx (xlsx), network-architecture-diagram.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
log an_wright@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0197

From: Anna Keller <anna.keller@brightleaf.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@brightleaf.io
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ session — scheduling and priority areas

Logan —

Thanks — Thu 2027-07-22 10:00–10:45 AM PST works for us. Please record; we’ll need the recording for our audit notes.

Priority sections we want to surface during the 45-minute session (in order):
1) Data residency + controls around backups and key management
2) Network segmentation & isolation between test/dev and prod; egress controls
3) IAM: provisioning, SSO integration, and log retention windows

If you can pre-share any sample logs or IAM policy snippets, that’d be great. I’ll invite our infra lead (rob.chen@brightleaf.io) to the call.

Anna

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Keller <anna.keller@brightleaf.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Rob Chen <rob.chen@brightleaf.io>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ session — scheduling and priority areas

Great — meeting confirmed for Thu 2027-07-22 10:00 AM PST (invite sent). We will record.

Pre-call artifacts we are sharing:
- Attached: CAIQ_v3_template.xlsx (pre-populated with pointers in sections 2, 6, and 11)
- Attached: network-architecture-diagram.pdf (annotated with VPC/segmentation callouts)
- Short archive of sample IAM audit log lines (snippet copied below)

Evidence owner assignments (confirmed):
- Data residency & KMS: Marissa Cole — will provide storage encryption keys references and backup policy excerpt
- Network segmentation & egress: Soojin Lee — will walk the diagram and point to routing/security group rules; will upload sanitized firewall rule sample on shared Drive after call
- IAM / logs retention: Logan Wright (me) — will present our SSO integration flow and retention table; will share sample audit log extract and retention policy link

On the call we’ll aim to allocate ~12–15 minutes per area with quick Q&A and follow-up actions. If any of your team wants deep dives, we can schedule targeted follow-ups.

Quick sample from IAM audit log (sanitized):
[2027-07-01T10:12:43Z] user=alice@brightleaf.io action=assume-role target=prod-inference role=service_read status=success
[2027-07-02T03:40:12Z] user=svc-batch@redwoodinference.com action=access-bucket target=prod-backups status=success

Attachments referenced: CAIQ_v3_template.xlsx, network-architecture-diagram.pdf

See you shortly —
Logan

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: brightleaf follow-ups and artifact handoff (post-call)

Internal note (after the call):

Call went well — Brightleaf wants the recording, CAIQ with our inline notes, an excerpt of KMS key policy, and a sanitized firewall rule export. Action items we committed to:
- Marissa: export and redact backup retention policy and KMS policy excerpt; add key rotation cadence (due 2027-07-26 EOD)
- Soojin: upload sanitized firewall/security group rules and annotate diagram (due 2027-07-25 5pm)
- Logan: publish sample IAM audit extract + retention table to Drive and share link; follow up with recorded meeting (due 2027-07-23 noon)

I also added a short follow-up doc to the Drive folder (see HubSpot: 4875123).

Thanks team — please confirm timelines in this thread.

- Logan
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
